The '''Mourner Headquarters''', also known as the '''Mourner HQ''', is the headquarters for the [[Mourner]]s, who are secretly the Death Guard of [[Prifddinas]] and members of the [[Iorwerth Clan]]. It is located in the north-eastern part of [[West Ardougne]] and plays a major role throughout the [[Elf quest|elf quest line]]. 

During the [[Elven Civil War]], the headquarters serves as a base of military and strategic operations for the Iorwerth Clan. After completion of [[Song of the Elves]], the building is taken over by the [[paladin]]s and [[Knight of Ardougne|knights of Ardougne]], and the [[Iorwerth warrior]]s relocate to the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]]. 

== Transportation ==

* [[West Ardougne Teleport|West Ardougne Teleport spell]] or [[West ardougne teleport (tablet)|tablet]]
* [[Ardougne Teleport|Ardougne Teleport spell]] or [[Ardougne teleport (tablet)|tablet]]
* [[Spirit tree]] to the [[Battlefield|Battlefield of Khazard]]
* [[Minigame teleport]] to the [[Rat Pits|Ardougne Rat Pit]]
* [[Slayer ring]] teleport to the [[Dark beast|Dark Beasts]] in the [[Mourner Tunnels]] (requires completion of [[Mourning's End Part II]])

== Outside ==
On the north end of the building is a fenced area containing a [[Cauldron (Mourner Headquarters)|cauldron]] and a [[rotten apple]]. This area can be accessed by squeezing through a [[Fence (Biohazard)|gap in the fence]].

A [[Mourner (Biohazard)#Mourner Headquarters door|Mourner]] carrying a staff guards the front entrance to the building.

== {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} ==
The {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} has several non-attackable [[Mourner (Biohazard)#Mourner Headquarters 1|Mourners]], a [[Range|range,]] and a [[sink]].

The western room contains:

* A [[Trapdoor (Mourner Headquarters)|trapdoor]] leading to the basement
* A staircase to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}

== {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} ==
The eastern room contains a level 13 [[Mourner (boss)|Mourner]] guarding the [[Gate (Biohazard)|gate]] of a cage filled with crates. During [[Biohazard]], the player must access this floor while wearing a [[medical gown]] to kill the Mourner, obtain a key, open the gate, and find [[Elena]]'s [[distillator]] in a crate. After completing the quest, the door at the top of the stairs becomes locked until [[Song of the Elves]] is completed. After Song of the Elves, the floor becomes accessible without restriction.

== Basement ==
The basement is accessed via the trapdoor on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} or via the  [[Door (Mourner Basement)|door connecting to the Mourner Tunnels]]. This door provides access to the:

* [[Mourner Tunnels]]
* [[Mourner Tunnels mine]]
* [[Temple of Light]]

During [[Song of the Elves]]{{Clarify|NPCs may change depending on which quests are done}}, the basement is patrolled by level 108 [[Mourner#level 108|Mourners]] and a [[Knight of Ardougne]]. A [[Gnome (Mourner Headquarters)|gnome]] is being held prisoner by a Mourner in the south-west room, and [[Essyllt]] can be found in the south-east room.

==Access==
Access to the headquarters changes throughout the elf quest series.

==== During [[Biohazard]] ====
The front entrance can be used only while wearing a [[medical gown]]. This gown cannot be removed while inside. After progressing further in the quest, the mourners will no longer allow entry using the medical gown. The basement is inaccessible.

==== During [[Mourning's End Part I]] ====
The front entrance can be used only after repairing and equipping the [[Mourner gear|full mourner outfit]]. The outfit must stay equipped at all times while inside the headquarters. The back door remains locked{{Clarify|Back door on main floor or basement door?}}.

==== During [[Mourning's End Part II]] ====
The {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and basement can be accessed via the [[Trapdoor (Mourner Headquarters)|trapdoor]] while wearing full mourner gear. Attempting to enter the basement without it results in the chatbox message: {{Mes|The trapdoor is bolted on the other side.}} Mourner gear cannot be removed inside the headquarters. Attempting to remove any piece of the outfit will result in the chatbox message: {{Mes|You should leave your disguise on while you're in the Mourner Headquarters.}} After obtaining the [[new key]], players can enter and exit the basement via the [[Door (Mourner Basement)|basement door]]. Entering the basement through the basement door or speaking to the [[Head Mourner]] without full mourner gear equipped will cause him to call for level 108 Mourners wielding [[Crystal halberd|crystal halberds]] to attack.

==== After Mourning's End Part II ====
A [[slayer ring]] can be used to teleport to the [[dark beast]]s west of the headquarters basement in the [[Mourner Tunnels]]. Mourner gear is not required to enter/re-enter the basement from the tunnels, though the mourners will be immediately aggressive.

==== During [[Song of the Elves]] ====
Immediately after completing the West Ardougne portion of the [[Song of the Elves#Causing an insurrection|Ardougne insurrection]] (killing 21 Mourners), all doors are unlocked and accessible without any additional gear or disguises. The only remaining NPCs in the headquarters are the [[Gnome (Mourner Headquarters)|gnome prisoner]] and a Knight of Ardougne. After the execution of [[King Lathas]], the headquarters are inhabited by [[Ardougne]] forces.
